abstract.text: Use the iOS handbook to create and manage work in the native app. Use the web handbook to explore Projects and Locations in a browser and to understand the website implementation.
Learn how LinkMap organizes shared places and work, use the iOS and web apps, and understand the implementation behind them.

The web app lets signed-in users explore Projects and Locations, while search and coordinate inspection work independently of iCloud sign-in. This branch contains the browser guide and the implementation and deployment notes.
The iOS app starts on the Map and supports Project setup, Activity planning, collaboration, and resource work. This branch contains the app guide and implementation notes grounded in LinkMap-core.
